ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed Plink Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of a renamed version of the Plink binary

sequences.query: (process_original_file_name = "Plink" OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-l\\ forward.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-P\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-R\\ .*"))) AND  NOT (process_path = RGX("\\\\plink\\\.exe$"))
